Cal (sales): Heads-up: NorthGate wants a POC to drop-in replace CompetitorX's /v1/generate. Top asks: prompt parity, predictable billing delta, SAML SSO, and BYOK for prod. Can we define POC gates they can sign off on?
Rina (solutions): Minimal gates: 1) API envelope shim, 2) canonical parity suite + human spot checks, 3) token accounting and billing delta calc, 4) security questionnaire + DPA check, 5) fallback model plan.
Omar (presales): I'll curate 10 canonical prompts (summarize, extract, rewrite, code) + 15 fuzz cases with emoji/unicode. Outputs captured side-by-side and scored (BLEU/ROUGE + simple semantic diff).
Lu (ML Eng): FYI CompetitorX tokenizes some smart quotes and regional emoji sequences differently; expect ~3-9% token variance on edge inputs. We'll include a "compat_tokenize" pre-normalize and a "mirror_mode" variant that tweaks repetition_penalty and top_p.
Bea (Security): For POC platform-managed KMS OK; production BYOK. Need SAML metadata, IP allowlist, retention <=30d. Legal requires DPA before we share raw prompts. Also confirm whether they need SOC2 + ISO statements in the questionnaire.
Cal (sales): NorthGate will accept managed KMS for the POC. They asked if we can keep the CompetitorX response envelope for a drop-in smoke test.
Rina (solutions): We can expose a lightweight shim. Example mapping (pseudo):
```
// competitor reply
{"id":"r123","output":"...","usage":{"tokens":120}}
// shim -> redwood-like
{"request_id":"r123","choices":[{"text":"..."}],"usage":{"total_tokens":120}}
```
Omar (presales): Acceptance criteria proposal: mean token delta <= 10% across canonical prompts, automated semantic score within threshold + human-pass >= 90% on sample, staging latency <= 1.5x competitor, no PII leakage in outputs.
Lu (ML Eng): For cost modeling: show both hosted and Dedicated numbers. Eg if token delta +7% on 40M tokens/month => +2.8M tokens cost at hosted rate. I'll add a simple calculator and include Dedicated per-token downrate options.
Bea (Security): Blocker: Legal/DPA must complete before we ship prompt logs. Also check export control if prompts contain technical specs.
prov-bot: staging cluster ready: northgate-poc (egress IPs: 18.65.43.21, 18.65.43.22)
Cal (sales): Thanks. Action items: @Omar build test harness + Postman collection, @Rina draft shim + fallback plan, @Lu prepare mirror_mode configs + seed, @Bea assemble security Q answers and loop Legal. I'll schedule kickoff Fri 11am PT. Ping me for blockers.
Omar (presales): I'll upload harness and canonical prompt TSV to the staging workspace before the call.
Lu (ML Eng): I'll commit the exact config + seed to the repo and link it in the workspace.
Bea (Security): Drafting the security answers now; will confirm whether on-prem evaluation is requested.
Cal (sales): Perfect. Keep updates here. If we hit regressions in semantic checks, we'll escalate to model tuning sprint.
